title: Notas da Tabela 10 — Terreno e Miniaturas — p. 100 (correção da publicação v3)

revisionBudget.rule: Render each complete, semantically equivalent alternative in PageRenderer before retaining it; never alter fonts, size, saved geometry, meaning, or insert padding to force a line count.

scopeLimits: This batch covers only the editable rule explanations beneath Table 10; card/component faces and printed game names remain original.
Figures is rendered locally as Miniaturas. The proper printed name Plank remains in English.
Current(s), Large Based Figures, and Heavy Tag remain local wording choices and do not approve new glossary-wide terms.
Source rich-span boundaries, source fonts, sizes, colors, and original English frames are preserved; only the localized first-cell frame uses the safe inside-cell corridor.

100%.method: scripts/measure_copyfit_page.mjs: PyMuPDF spans are first grouped by their source line object, then distinct source lines are grouped by representative baseline (1 pt tolerance). Rich runs in one line object remain one visual row. Inline uppercase callout markers and a separate Cinzel quantity glyph beside a declared weapon-hand symbol are folded into the adjacent prose row only when their ink boxes overlap. Live PT-BR PageRenderer text rects plus visible semantic-symbol rects for symbol-only rows are clustered by vertical centre (0.5 x median rect height); inline symbols overlapping a text row count with that row, not as extra lines. Candidate text and symbol IDs must match the selected renderer unit. For image-backed/raster-restored source text whose PDF extraction is incomplete, a candidate-scoped sourceVisualLineCountOverride may be used only with documented visual evidence. No character count, string newline count or frame-height estimate was used.

revisions.summary: Retrospective preflight explicitly tested the measured maximum safe semantic width; both zooms remain OVER 4/3, so the DTP exception stays open.

Reabri as duas traduções já publicadas sob review keys v3 para corrigir fidelidade sem criar conflito de revisão. Terrain Tokens foi substituído pelo significado correto “não são movidos pelas Correntes” (a publicação anterior dizia bloquear Linha de Visão/movimento); Figures foi atualizado com a redação curta e HEAVY → PESADO/PESADA. O frame da célula esquerda foi limitado ao corredor seguro de 158.999 pt. Medir e republicar com os mesmos review keys para preservar o histórico das publicações anteriores.

note: Both localized Table 10 rule notes are 3/3 and 4/4 EXACT at 100% and 200%, using the measured PT-BR first-cell frame. The preview matched the source row count and styles. Existing approved reviews v3 must be revised through the official endpoint so prior publication data remains in history; no write has occurred yet.
